title: Billy Crystal: 860 on Broadway #billycrystal #billycrystal860 #broadw...
transcript: Billy Crystal tragically lost his family home in the 2025 Palisades fire, and like any sensible comedian, he made a Broadway show about it — well, sort of. The fire is what bookends the piece, which is otherwise more of a trip down memory lane, a greatest hits of his career and the friendships he's made along the way. There's definitely a target demographic for this show, which I don't think I fall into. As someone who's not well-versed in his career, I enjoyed learning about his life, though there was a lot of name-dropping, names that didn't mean anything to me, as they were before my time. It seems like all of the cultural references are meant to evoke nostalgia, and while it's a little one-note for 100 minutes, it is not a bad time.
